summary: Iteration 4: 1v1 invite-by-username flow + no-seed-data verification. Created /app/backend/tests/test_invite_flow.py with 12 focused tests covering: no-seed guardrails (admin present, demo removed, no sample tournaments), user search prefix/exclusion rules, invite creation (404 non-existent, 400 self, success with balance deduction + pending stake + challenge_invite notif to opponent), privacy (invited challenge hidden from public /challenges list, appears only in ?invites=true for the invited user), 403 wrong-user accept, 403 wrong-user decline, decline refund + challenge_declined notif, invite accept flow with stake lock, and creator cancel refund + challenge_invite_cancelled notif. All 12/12 passed in 15s. Frontend verified on 390x844 mobile viewport: (1) Login screen has NO pre-filled credentials (email and password empty on first load, no 'demo' hint). (2) Create Challenge shows Open (default active) / Invite mode toggle via [mode-open]/[mode-invite]; toggling to Invite reveals [opponent-search-input]; typing 'UIopp' calls /api/users/search and shows suggestion pill with rank+wins; tapping the suggestion (testid opponent-pick-<username>) locks selection and the submit button label changes from 'CREATE CHALLENGE - $X' to 'SEND INVITE - $X'. (3) Play tab shows OPEN/INVITES/MY MATCHES subtabs ([play-tab-open], [play-tab-invites], [play-tab-mine]); INVITES tab shows the pending invite card for the invited opponent. (4) Challenge detail for invited opponent shows both [challenge-decline-btn] and [challenge-accept-btn] side-by-side with a 'PRIVATE INVITE' badge. (5) Home tab shows red badge '1' on [home-notifications-btn] when unread notifs exist. (6) Notifications screen: notif row testid pattern notif-<uuid>, unread green dot rendered, tapping the row navigates to /challenge/<ref_id> correctly. Fresh-DB confirmed end-to-end: Home shows 'No open challenges' and empty Upcoming Events for new users.

issues: Notification row uses green unread dot on right edge - visible and clear at 390px. Tapping row marks read and navigates as expected.
Decline and Accept buttons render side-by-side at bottom action bar - clear, 44px+ touch targets. PRIVATE INVITE badge distinguishes invite from open challenge.
Autocomplete suggestion pill shows avatar + username + Rank/Wins - good affordance. Submit label transitions Open->Invite correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/users/search correctly excludes self, admin, and suspended users per test coverage. Case-insensitive prefix match via regex works as intended.

server.py: private invite privacy is enforced at the list level (list_challenges omits invited unless invites=true is set AND the requester is the invited opponent) - validated by third-party user unable to see the invited challenge in /challenges.

server.py: decline endpoint correctly refunds creator stake (wallet_balance +stake, pending_balance -stake) and issues challenge_declined notification with category='challenge' and ref_id=challenge_id.
Frontend notifications.tsx: notification row testid pattern notif-<uuid> works cleanly; tapping marks read via API and router.push('/challenge/'+ref_id) navigates as expected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login empty, create-challenge mode toggle+autocomplete, play INVITES tab, challenge detail accept/decline, home bell badge, notif tap navigation)

seed_data_creation: Each test in test_invite_flow.py provisions its own fresh TEST_inv_* users via /auth/register + /auth/verify-email + /auth/login + /auth/verify-2fa, and tops up wallet_balance directly via pymongo when funding is required. For frontend UI testing, registered 2 users via public /api/auth/*: TEST_ui_creator_36850d@matchpoint.gg (username UIcreator393b) and TEST_ui_opp_93453b@matchpoint.gg (username UIopp5de9), then created a $10 invite challenge (id b451e4f0-...) between them to exercise the invited-opponent detail screen and notification tap flow.
